findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Missing timeout configuration
 * @description Network operations without timeouts can lead to resource exhaustion
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/missing-timeout
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-400
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("socket").getMember("socket").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("socket").getMember(["create_connection", "connect"]).getACall()
  ) and
  not exists(DataFlow::Node timeout |
    timeout = call.getArgByName("timeout") or
    timeout = call.getArg(2)
  )
select call, "Network operation without timeout configuration may lead to resource exhaustion."
findings.hypothesis: Network operations without timeouts can lead to resource exhaustion and DoS

message.text: Network operation without timeout configuration may lead to resource exhaustion.
Network operation without timeout configuration may lead to resource exhaustion.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Improper URL validation
 * @description Lack of proper URL validation can lead to SSRF or other injection attacks
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/improper-url-validation
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-918
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, string method
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("parse").getMember(["urlparse", "urlsplit"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("socket").getMember("getaddrinfo").getACall()
  ) and
  method = "URL parsing"
select call, "URL parsing operation that may not properly validate input for SSRF protection."
findings.hypothesis: Check for URL parsing without proper validation that could lead to SSRF

message.text: URL parsing operation that may not properly validate input for SSRF protection.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Sensitive information in exception messages
 * @description Exception messages that contain sensitive information may leak data
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/sensitive-info-in-exception
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-209
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from Raise raise_stmt, StrConst msg
where
  msg = raise_stmt.getException().getAChildNode*() and
  (
    msg.getText().toLowerCase().matches("%password%") or
    msg.getText().toLowerCase().matches("%token%") or
    msg.getText().toLowerCase().matches("%key%") or
    msg.getText().toLowerCase().matches("%secret%")
  )
select raise_stmt, "Exception message may contain sensitive information: " + msg.getText()
findings.hypothesis: Check if exception messages contain sensitive information like passwords or tokens

message.text: Exception message may contain sensitive information: Invalid username/password
Exception message may contain sensitive information: Invalid username/password
